task: Quantitative model of pulmonary surfactant + alveolar (Laplace) stability: P=2*gamma/r at r~0.1mm (bare-saline 50-70 mN/m vs surfactant-lowered <5-10 mN/m); a surface-tension-vs-area hysteresis loop; and the PRIMARY falsifier -- a two-alveolus ODE model proving constant gamma makes unequal-radius alveoli unstable (small empties into large) while area-dependent gamma with steep dgamma/dA>0 stabilizes the equal-radius state, derived from the geometry (a power-law surface law makes the Laplace pressure an exact power law in r, sign-flipping at n=1/2) and forced across a 160-instance exponent/perturbation/direction sweep plus a wrong-signed adversary. Cross-checked against the saline-vs-air ~3-4x whole-lung ratio (Radford/Clements/Bachofen).
confidence_tier: mechanism-plausibility, geometrically-forced, with one directly-measured calibration anchor. The n=1/2 stability threshold is derived TWICE independently (closed-form power-law algebra; linearized two-alveolus ODE) and cross-checked to machine precision (2.85e-11 relative error) -- this part is as solid as the underlying math, not merely literature-plausible. The calibration placing real physiology at n=6.17 (12.34x past threshold) rests on ONE live-verified in-situ primary measurement (Schurch 1982, 2 data points, not a multi-point regression). RDS/clinical framing rests on foundational (Avery-Mead 1959) plus modern (Hooper 2013, Diggikar 2024) live-verified sources; the 3 pre-1975 foundational papers (Clements 1957, Avery-Mead 1959, Bachofen 1970) are bibliographically confirmed live (title/journal/volume/pages/DOI) but have no MEDLINE-indexed abstract text (pre-1975 records), disclosed not hidden. Comparable to this repo's own MECHANISM_MAPK_ERK_SIGNALING.md precedent (geometrically-derived threshold + a small number of directly-measured calibration anchors).

self_qc_catches_this_session.type: confounded adversary comparison (not a citation error, but the identical 'force the adversary to its strongest FAIR form' discipline applied to a numerical experiment design)
self_qc_catches_this_session.claim: a 'wrong-signed' surfactant (gamma increases on compression, n<0) should be MORE unstable (collapse faster) than plain constant gamma (n=0)
self_qc_catches_this_session.initial_result: n=-1 and n=0 produced numerically IDENTICAL terminal D_ratio (6.11185...) -- a suspicious, uninformative non-result
self_qc_catches_this_session.diagnosed_root_cause: k was held fixed at 1.0 across different n values, but gamma-at-the-reference-radius = k*(4*pi)^n itself swings by orders of magnitude as n varies -- so 'more negative n' was confounded with 'much weaker absolute tension', not a fair like-for-like comparison. The SIGN-only stability classification (used everywhere else in the regime map) is unaffected by this confound (sign(f')=sign(2n-1) regardless of k), but a cross-n RATE/TIMING comparison is not.
self_qc_catches_this_session.fix: re-normalized so gamma-at-reference-radius (not k) is held fixed across n: k = gamma_ref/(4*pi*r0^2)^n. Re-run gave a clean, monotonic result: time-to-collapse 10.17/6.18/2.79 (n=0) > 3.01/1.72/0.68 (n=-1) > 1.02/0.50/0.14 (n=-3) at all 3 tested perturbation sizes (eps=0.05/0.10/0.20), no exceptions.
self_qc_catches_this_session.note: a one-shot vacuous result was not accepted as an 'honest negative' -- Orient (diagnose the confound) before Decide/Act (fair renormalization) before re-testing, exactly the OODA discipline applied to a model-design choice rather than a literature claim.

self_qc_catches_this_session.type: units bug (dimensional-consistency self-QC on a numerical result, not a literature claim)
self_qc_catches_this_session.claim: the P-A hysteresis loop area, in real Joules per alveolus per breath cycle
self_qc_catches_this_session.initial_result: P values computed as ~1e-5 to 1e-1 with no dimensional grounding -- k had been calibrated against REAL mN/m units at a reference radius r_ref=1.0, then reused inside a DIMENSIONLESS radius grid (0.7 to 1.3, matching the two-alveolus model's normalized convention) -- so 2*k*A^n/r did not actually reduce to Pascals.
self_qc_catches_this_session.fix: rebuilt part2b_hysteresis_loop entirely in real physical units: r0=1e-4 m (matching Part 1's alveolar radius), actual meter-scale r range, k calibrated in real N/m directly from Schurch 1982's mN/m numbers at the corresponding physical radius. P now comes out in real Pascals (converted to cmH2O for reporting) and loop area in real Joules (Pa*m^2).
self_qc_catches_this_session.note: caught BEFORE any number was reported in the doc, by asking 'does this number's UNIT make physical sense' rather than just checking the PASS/FAIL gate (which was, and remains, unaffected by this bug -- the gate is a ratio/relative comparison, valid regardless of absolute units).

Bachofen 1970, Clements 1957, Avery-Mead 1959: bibliographically confirmed live (title/journal/volume/pages/DOI) but pre-1975 MEDLINE records with no indexed abstract text -- no numeric extraction from PubMed itself for these 3 foundational papers.

The exact saline-vs-air ~3-4x P-V curve figure is the task's own specified, textbook-transmitted magnitude, not independently machine-extracted from Bachofen 1970's primary full text (paywalled, no OA copy found).

The two-alveolus model deliberately isolates the surface-tension mechanism only -- no tissue elastic recoil, no septal/structural interdependence, both real contributors to alveolar stability in vivo. Intentional scope (matches the task's own falsifier), not an oversight.

The shared-airway-junction equal-resistance instantaneous-flow-balance ODE construction is a standard illustrative vehicle (the classic two-connected-balloons thought experiment), not itself a literature-measured airway-resistance network; the rate constant is an explicitly normalized/arbitrary timescale -- only the SIGN of the stability criterion (geometrically forced) is the physical claim, not absolute dynamics.
gamma(A)=k*A^n is a 2-point calibration (Schurch 1982's 70%/40% TLC values), not a multi-point regression against the full nonlinear, history-dependent real surfactant isotherm.
A~V^(2/3) isotropic-scaling assumption converts %TLC data to an area ratio -- standard but unverified-this-session (real alveoli are polyhedral, lung inflation not perfectly isotropic).
The hysteresis loop's inflation-branch offset (2.2x) is illustrative/disclosed, not measured this session -- only the deflation-branch slope is Schurch-1982-calibrated.

No specific neonatal 'critical opening pressure = X cmH2O' clinical number was machine-extracted from a live full-text fetch this session -- Hooper 2013 / Diggikar 2024 give qualitative/mechanistic clinical context, not one crisp verified figure.

Single representative alveolar pair, not a network of the ~480 million real human alveoli (Ochs 2004, PMID 14512270, reused by reference from this repo's own MECHANISM_PULMONARY_GAS_EXCHANGE.md, not re-fetched) -- a deliberately small model per the task's own instruction.
